visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a vibrant food stall environment. A large takoyaki grill with empty spherical molds is prominent in the immediate foreground. To the right, a female staff member wearing a black uniform and a red-patterned headband is partially visible, gesturing with her hand toward the back. Centrally located behind a glass counter is a humanoid robot dressed as a chef, featuring a round, smiling face, a black shirt with white text, and a traditional Japanese headband. The lighting is bright and typical of an indoor commercial market. (2) The camera zooms in to a close-up of the robot's mechanical arms. These arms are equipped with dispensers that precisely squeeze red and yellow sauces onto a tray of takoyaki. The tray is shaped like a red octopus character. The robot's facial expression remains a static, wide-eyed smile. The background shows various packaged goods and Japanese signage on red and white banners. (3) The camera pulls back to a medium shot. The robot continues its rhythmic mechanical motions, moving its arms back and forth. The female staff member on the right reaches forward, picks up the finished octopus-themed tray of takoyaki from a small conveyor platform, and holds it up toward the camera with a cheerful expression. The surrounding environment remains bustling with a shallow depth of field.
